newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS confirms Magna Intl ratings.
newsitem.headline: DBRS confirms Magna Intl ratings.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Tuesday it confirmed the ratings on Magna International Inc's senior debt, convertible subordinated debentures and commercial paper at A, A(low) and R-1(low), respectively, with positive trends.
DBRS said Magna's balance sheet continues to be strong and conservatively leveraged and the company still has a significant amount of cash on hand to fund acquisitions.

The bond rating service said Magna's balance sheet and liquidity position are expected to remain favorable through fiscal 1997 although there is uncertainty about the long-term stability of the company's financial profile due to its aggressive acquisition strategy.

Although the North American auto cycle appears to have peaked, Magna is expected to continue to show improvement in earnings through fiscal 1997, helped by new vehicle launches and productivity gains, said DBRS.
